name: tnt_breaks_double_slabs
description: TNT goes off on an obsidian floor among slabs and other blocks whose loot tables set or decay a count. Each double slab drops two slabs (set_count when type=double), a bottom or top slab drops one, the composter at level 8 drops itself and bone meal, and the cobweb drops string. TNT explosions don't decay drops by default (tnt_explosion_drop_decay is off), so every item survives.
